svg.text: ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT: 3-FOOT TIMBER TREBUCHET (3-YARD MARBLE LAUNCH)
CONSTRUCTION: RECTANGULAR WOODEN STICKS, PVA GLUE, BOLTED JOINERY, 8mm STEEL ROD & 2x 608 BALL BEARINGS

g.text: SHOWING 8mm METAL ROD AXLE & 2x 608 BALL BEARINGS
DUAL 608-2RS BALL BEARINGS ON 8mm STEEL ROD
395g WEIGHT SCREWED TO SHORT STICK END
DETAIL D: CLOTH POUCH CUTOUT (16mm MARBLE)
• Material: Heavy Cotton Canvas or Denim
• Flat Pattern Size: 85 mm x 48 mm
• 2x Side Darts: Folded & stitched into 3D cup
SIMULATED RANGE: 3.00 Yards (2.739 m @ V=4.76 m/s, 47.8°)
Pine Sticks, Glue, Bolts, 8mm Rod, 608 Bearings
1. GLUE & BOLT JOINTS: Apply PVA wood glue (Titebond II/III) to all mating stick lap joints, clamp firmly, and drill clearance holes for 1/4" bolts.
2. BEARING HOUSING: Drill 22mm Forstner bit recesses into upright pillow blocks. Press-fit 608-2RS ball bearings flush with inner faces.
3. FULCRUM AXLE: Slide 8mm steel round rod through bearings and pre-drilled 8mm hole in swing stick. Install retaining washers to prevent lateral shift.
4. COUNTERWEIGHT: Drill 3/8" hole through short end of swing stick. Screw 395g steel weight stack tightly using 3/8" bolt, lock washer, and hex nut.
5. SLING CALIBRATION: Leather shoe-lace length is 17.3". If marble launches too late/steep, bend 45° pin slightly forward; if too low, bend pin back.
